integrity: The all-exponent claim has an explicit mathematical proof. Exact finite checks independently corroborate 299592 cubic cases and many higher recurrence levels. Self-review is not an independent certification.
scientific_limitations: Only uniformly sampled monic cubics modulo powers of two; not nonmonic coefficients, other degrees, other primes, or actual Q_2-root statistics. Earliest motivating preprint full text inaccessible; a prior equivalent formula is a historical-priority risk. Independent audit not performed.
title: Complete dyadic cubic root-count recurrence and sharp extremal law
